answers.reason: The senate is a central body of the whole university and the junior professor is not described as a member of it.
The budget planning round is managed by central leadership rather than being a body the junior professor participates in.
Junior professors hold a professorship and take part in faculty matters related to their role.
The junior professor is a member of the faculty and takes part where their faculty matters are decided.
Study commission deals with degree programmes and teaching relevant to faculty members including professors.
Examination boards deal with individual student examination matters rather than general professorial duties.
Internal research funding is for research projects which concerns professors building research groups.
Module revisions are handled within degree programmes by respective teaching staff.
Laboratory equipment procurement is handled by specialized working rounds not general faculty bodies.
Orientation week planning is typically for student representatives and student affairs.
